name: secure-firewall-assistant
description: Configure and validate enrolled Cisco Secure Firewall lab devices through local REST and optional SSH tools.

interface.longDescription: Uses your private local inventory and a local YAML credential file for lab devices. Discovers supported FMC operations from the supplied OpenAPI reference, verifies saved configuration, and offers optional bounded FTD diagnostics. Deployment requires an explicit request.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the configuration on my selected FMC and report the evidence.
